Mediastinum: b/n lungs     -contains rest of thoracic viscera (except lungs)
Rt & Lt pleural cavity: lines w parietal & visceral pleurae   -  Lungs enclosed via serous membrane

A/P vs Transverse diameter: visual estimate
barrel chest: look @ A/P to lat/transverse ratio:
Norm=1:2, 2x lat/transverse as deep      -    Abnorm=1:1, lat/transverse=deep
Cause: chronic air trapping -COPD, Asthma, Emphysema
Exhale less than pt inhales =progressively enlarge chest
Can tx underlying but anatomic chg = permanent
Pectus carinatum: out -⍉ affect lungs but poss connective tissue dz Sx
Spinal deviation: Kyphosis: ↓lung space -thoracic spine problem, osteoporosis w compression fx
Fingers: clubbing (vasodilation), nicotine stain, burns from drug/crack use
Breath: halitosis -infections or poss from dental source
Skin, Nails, Lips: cyanosis or pallor -central or peripheral
Rate: 12-20 breath/min             -    Hyperpnea (hyperventilation): ±20, very deep, ↑ acidity
Bradypnea: <12        -    Tachypnea ±20, norm depth, quick shallow breaths
Deep abd, laboured, gasping -Lots of hyper inspiration & expiration ->chg acidity levels
K: ketones (DKA)            -    S: Sepsis                  -    A: Aldehydes
U: Uremia                       -    S: Salicylates            -    L: Lactic acid, lactic acidosis
Periodic breathing: gradual hypopnea -> hyperpnea -> hypopnea & apnea
Sleep, hypoxemia, drugs             -    Hypoperfusion of brain -resp center
Biot Respiration (ataxic resp): neuronal damage (brain, pons)  -irregular
Use of access musc: body ⍉maintain for long b4  “give out”     -    Abd breathing
Pursed lip breathing: ↑ velocity -> ↑ P                                         -    Nasal flaring
Thoracic Musc/Skeleton          -    Rigidity or curvature of thoracic spine
Masses                    -    Unusual mvt/positions          -    Is pain reprod w palpation?
Friction Rub                                                                 -    Palpable, coarse, grating vibration
Usually on inspiration                                  -    Stops when hold breath
Violation of cavity -> air can get in -> crepitus
Resp expansion/chest excursion -GET HANDS ON SIDES
Thumbs @ 10th rib (T10) -> expand equally w expansion
Unilat: Sx of underlying resp issue
Tactile Fremitus -cross arms to displace ribs, P =4, A =4, Lat =3   **↑:in fluid connected to bronchi
Pt say ‘99’ -> Use ulnar surface -> feel vibratory sensation transmitted via lungs
Consolidation/air needs connection to bronchi to chg tactile fremitus
Can be subtle -> used to confirm ausc findings        -Stronger if consolidation
↓ or absent   -     Voice too soft         -    excess air              -    Pleural effusion
Pneumonia: Consolidation w/in lungs (connected to bronchi) -> ↑ tactile fremitus
Pathophysiology: fluid filling air space in alveoli
Pneumothorax: Air unconnected to bronchi -> ↓ tactile fremitus
Effusion: consolidation in pleural space: Fluid unconnected to bronchi -> ↓tactile fremitus
Infiltrate: substance (pus, fluid, blood, cells) fill lungs airspaces
Consolidation: specific type of infiltrate -> dense that obscures cells
Poss causes:                      -    Intra-pulm hemorrhage          -     Lung CA
Effusion: fluid accumulate outside lung in pleural space
Sets body surface & underlying tissues in motion     -    Dullness -bone, fluid, solid organ
Give rise to diff sounds:    -    Loudness (intensity)   -    pitch (↑ or ↓)   -    duration
-    ⍉ else touch chest cavity   -    Angle correctly   -    Long finger nails
Gastric Bubble (traubes space): full resonance -> midclavicular ICS 6, midaxillary ICS 9, rib lining
Start ~T8 (I angle of scapula) -> expect hollow    - resonant -> filled w lung, dull b/c solid tissue
If ⍉ move as expected -> ascites        -    damage to phrenic        -    abd mass      -    preg
Anatomically: diaphragm is higher riding on Rt than Lt -b/c liver is  ↓mobile
Norm: 3-5cm, athletes up to 7cm (lrg tidal vol), tall pt can be lrger
